Olivia (sales): Heads-up — FinPay POC failing. They POST a 2.1MB JSON payload to /v1/chat and get truncation + 413. Demo in 3 hours.

Raj (eng): That's the LB/gateway limit. Also note model context limits will drop most of it. Can you paste their client sample?

Olivia (sales): They POST messages[0].content with entire transactions JSON blob. No attachments.

Tom (solutions): Demo cheat: swap their endpoint for a proxy we control. Proxy accepts the large body, stores it, and returns a short id. Their UI then calls our /chat?context_id=id. Minimal client change (endpoint URL).

Maya (eng-ml): Important: even if proxy stores the blob, passing the whole blob into the model will overflow token limits. For faithful QA, proxy should run a retrieval step or exact-snippet lookup and only send the matched records to the model.

Olivia (sales): Customer insists on verbatim context for some queries. Any demo-safe way to emulate that?

Raj (eng): We can implement a snippet service: store raw JSON, on query run a fast filter (regex/key match) and return exact matching JSON fragments. Feed those fragments into the prompt. Looks and feels like in-context exact match but stays under token limits.

Tom (solutions): For the browser-only client, recommend presigned PUT to S3 + single POST of metadata (s3_url) to chat. That avoids LB limit entirely and is secure. For the demo, proxy approach is fastest.

gateway-bot: Created ticket GATE-892: evaluate raising hosted JSON body limit (risk: downstream services, DoS).

Maya (eng-ml): Pricing note: indexing/embedding the corpus once costs embedding units; retrieval queries add prompt tokens and inference cost. If we only do snippet lookup (no embeddings), cost is just inference tokens for returned fragments. Clarify with FinPay.

Raj (eng): I'll stand up the proxy and the snippet lookup. Tom, can you draft the one-paragraph customer note?

Olivia (sales): Great — please paste the proxy URL and a short customer-friendly explanation I can send. Trying to keep this low-friction for the demo. :pray:
